inspiration.observed_pattern: A parent-and-child report projects several CASE WHEN EXISTS flags, including correlated date thresholds, while LEFT JOINs retain parents and expose repeated child activity rows.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reauthored as a member-program activity report. Correlated EXISTS projections classify ownership, any activity, activity after one week, and activity after one month; LEFT JOINs preserve members without programs and expose deterministic activity rows. SQL Server identifiers and DATEADD syntax are replaced with newly authored MariaDB tables, literals, and DATE_ADD expressions.

fixture_notes: Member 701 owns a program with activity before and after one week; member 702 owns a program with activity after one week and one month; member 703 owns no program and must remain through the LEFT JOIN with zero flags. Repeated activity rows make the EXISTS flags observable independently of the joined child row.
determinism_notes: Member, program, and activity IDs and dates are fixed; output is ordered by member, program, and activity IDs with no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent schedules.
setup: CREATE TABLE activity_members (member_id INT PRIMARY KEY, member_name VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, joined_on DATE NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE activity_programs (program_id INT PRIMARY KEY, owner_id INT NOT NULL, created_on DATE NOT NULL, program_name VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE program_activity (activity_id INT PRIMARY KEY, program_id INT NOT NULL, activity_on DATE NOT NULL, activity_kind VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL)

steps.sql: SELECT m.member_id, p.program_id, a.activity_id, CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM activity_programs owned WHERE owned.owner_id = m.member_id) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS owns_program, CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM program_activity any_activity WHERE any_activity.program_id = p.program_id) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_activity, CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM program_activity weekly_activity WHERE weekly_activity.program_id = p.program_id AND weekly_activity.activity_on > DATE_ADD(p.created_on, INTERVAL 7 DAY)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS active_after_week, CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM program_activity monthly_activity WHERE monthly_activity.program_id = p.program_id AND monthly_activity.activity_on > DATE_ADD(p.created_on, INTERVAL 1 MONTH)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS active_after_month FROM activity_members m LEFT JOIN activity_programs p ON p.owner_id = m.member_id LEFT JOIN program_activity a ON a.program_id = p.program_id ORDER BY m.member_id, p.program_id, a.activity_id
